[P2] Require the original deadline peer to complete successfully

The deadline-specific `healthy_peer()` checks original-request heartbeats and gate release, but accepts the execution result regardless of which invocation produced it. If the original peer is interrupted after its barrier checkpoint, a retry can skip that barrier and complete, satisfying every check despite disrupting the companion. Apply the original-request `peer-after` and successful `RETURN` assertions already added to `healthy_after()` here as well. Add a deadline-case negative control where only a retry completes after the original gate release.
